name: Repair JSON pointer lookup
prompt: Read README.md and the implementation. Repair the contract, add a new meaningful regression test file, and verify using the exact public command with source read-only. Report observed results.

public.README.md:
# Repair JSON pointer lookup

Follow an RFC6901-style pointer in a JSON object/array. Empty pointer selects the root. Decode ~1 as slash and ~0 as tilde in each component. Reject malformed escapes, missing keys, noncanonical array indices (including leading zero), and out-of-range traversal by returning null. A root string is permitted.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `go test ./...`. No external dependencies are needed.
